title: Customer tradeoff interviews: latency vs accuracy vs cost for RAG workflows
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Objective:
Run a rapid set of qualitative interviews with 8–12 engineering and product leaders at current customers and target accounts to surface concrete tradeoffs they make between latency, model accuracy (or hallucination risk), and per-inference cost for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) use cases.

Why this ticket exists:
- We have many quantitative benchmarks (latency/cost) but lack grounded buyer stories that explain where customers are willing to tolerate quality regressions for speed/cost, and where accuracy is non‑negotiable.
- Findings will feed: model variant prioritization, routing/fallback policies, default batch/cache recommendations in Optimize, and a short sales enablement brief.

Hypotheses to test:
1) Enterprise RAG deployments are willing to accept ~10–20% accuracy drop if tail latency decreases >200ms for conversational assistants.
2) Customers in regulated verticals prioritize deterministic outputs and are less tolerant of quantized models even if cheaper.
3) Sales teams overestimate price sensitivity for mid-market customers using chat summarization (they value latency more than incremental cost savings).

Method and deliverables:
- Interview guide (10–12 questions) + consent script.
- Target sample: 4 current hosted API customers, 4 Dedicated/Private prospects (mix of fintech, SaaS, enterprise search).
- Recorded notes and a short 1‑pager synthesizing patterns and concrete thresholds (latency delta, cost delta, accuracy drop) per buyer persona.
- A one-slide sales enablement snapshot and recommended feature flags for canary rollouts (e.g., default model routing: low-latency pool for "chat-lite").

Success metrics:
- 8 completed interviews with usable artifacts.
- Clear, actionable thresholds for at least two personas (e.g., "support chat bot" and "research assistant").
- At least one product decision (routing default or Optimize recommendation) documented and accepted by ENG/Console PMs.

Dependencies:
- Sales to provide a list of candidate interviewees and intro emails.
- Legal to sign off on consent language (if recording).
- ENG telemetry team to share aggregated latency-percentile data for sample customers (to contextualize responses).
